source: FTA Bulletin · Corporate Tax Losses · 25 June 2026
headline: TAX LOSSES WON'T
WIPE OUT

blocks.text: Our tax losses will cover all of next year's profit.

items: Losses can cut only **75%** of a year's taxable income.
Losses before **1 June 2023**, or before you became taxable, don't count.
Ownership changed by **over 50%**? Keep the **same or a similar business**.
